cases.name: mix-exact-percents
cases.description: A mix apportions its cases exactly, like percent= elsewhere

cases.name: mix-nested
cases.description: A nested mix apportions within the rows its parent case selected
cases.config: <tdc><env count="40" seed="nested-mix-sequence" local="en" mode="memory"><mix name="Code" percent="50,50"><case><data>A</data><mix percent="25,75"><case><data>X</data></case><case><data>Y</data></case></mix></case><case><data>B</data></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{Code}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: mix-generator-in-a-case
cases.description: A generator inside a case runs only for the rows that chose it
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="case-regex-sequence" local="en" mode="memory"><mix name="Code" percent="50,50"><case><data>A-</data><gen type="regex" value="[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{2}"/></case><case><data>B</data></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{Code}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: mix-advanced-regex-in-a-case
cases.description: A weighted choice inside a case applies to that case's subset
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="case-advanced-regex-sequence" local="en" mode="memory"><mix name="Code" percent="50,50"><case><gen type="advanced_regex" value="A-(?%{20:X;80:Y})"/></case><case><data>B</data></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{Code}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: mix-respects-parent
cases.description: A parent filter applies before the mix percentages
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="parent-mix-sequence" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Gender"><gen type="text" value="M,F" percent="50,50"/></sequence><mix name="Code" parent="Gender.M" percent="40,60"><case><data>X</data></case><case><data>Y</data></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{Gender}}:${{Code}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: mix-flag-marks-the-branch
cases.description: flag= marks exactly the rows that took the anomalous case
cases.config: <tdc><env count="20" seed="mix-flag" local="en" mode="memory"><mix name="Reading" percent="80,20" flag="Bad"><case><gen type="number" value="50..65"/></case><case anomaly="true"><gen type="number" value="118..122"/></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{Reading}}|${{Bad}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: switch-map-with-default
cases.description: A map table, with a default for everything unlisted
cases.config: <tdc><env count="25" seed="sw" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Country"><gen type="text" value="US,FR,DE,JP,ZZ" percent="20,20,20,20,20"/></sequence><switch name="Currency" on="Country"><map>US:USD, FR:EUR, DE:EUR, JP:JPY</map><default><data>OTHER</data></default></switch></env><block><line><data>${{Country}}|${{Currency}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: switch-multi-key-map
cases.description: One map row can list several keys
cases.config: <tdc><env count="12" seed="sw-multi" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="C"><gen type="text" value="CA,MX,FR" percent="34,33,33"/></sequence><switch name="Cur" on="C"><map>CA|MX:USD, FR:EUR</map></switch></env><block><line><data>${{C}}|${{Cur}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: switch-no-default-leaves-empty
cases.description: Without a default an unmatched row is empty, not an error
cases.config: <tdc><env count="25" seed="sw" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Country"><gen type="text" value="US,FR,DE,JP,ZZ" percent="20,20,20,20,20"/></sequence><switch name="Currency" on="Country"><map>US:USD, FR:EUR</map></switch></env><block><line><data>${{Country}}|${{Currency}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: switch-first-match-wins
cases.description: The first matching entry wins, and a map is read before a case
cases.config: <tdc><env count="25" seed="sw" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Country"><gen type="text" value="US,FR,DE,JP,ZZ" percent="20,20,20,20,20"/></sequence><switch name="Currency" on="Country"><map>US:FROM_MAP</map><case is="US"><data>FROM_CASE</data></case><default><data>?</data></default></switch></env><block><line><data>${{Country}}|${{Currency}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: switch-splits-on-first-colon
cases.description: A map row splits on the first colon, so colons survive in a value
cases.config: <tdc><env count="25" seed="sw" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Country"><gen type="text" value="US,FR,DE,JP,ZZ" percent="20,20,20,20,20"/></sequence><switch name="Currency" on="Country"><map>US:Test : Down</map><default><data>?</data></default></switch></env><block><line><data>${{Country}}|${{Currency}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: switch-multi-key-case
cases.description: A case can list several keys with is="A|B"
cases.config: <tdc><env count="25" seed="sw" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Country"><gen type="text" value="US,FR,DE,JP,ZZ" percent="20,20,20,20,20"/></sequence><switch name="Currency" on="Country"><case is="US|FR"><data>WEST</data></case><default><data>?</data></default></switch></env><block><line><data>${{Country}}|${{Currency}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: switch-case-with-generator
cases.description: A case may hold a generator, not only literal text
cases.config: <tdc><env count="25" seed="sw" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Country"><gen type="text" value="US,FR,DE,JP,ZZ" percent="20,20,20,20,20"/></sequence><switch name="Currency" on="Country"><map>US:USD</map><case is="ZZ"><data>X-</data><gen type="regex" value="[0-9]{3}"/></case><default><data>?</data></default></switch></env><block><line><data>${{Country}}|${{Currency}}</data></line></block></tdc>
